result:
This confirms `knownFolders.currentApp().path + '/assets/sample.wav'` resolves correctly to the bundled file — the app's runtime root is `.app/app/`, matching where `bundle.mjs` lives alongside `assets/`.

The build passes. Summary of changes for Phase 3 (Transcribe / Speech):

- **`app/services/speech.ts`** (new) — wraps `SFSpeechRecognizer`/`SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` for authorization status/request and streaming transcription of the bundled file via partial-results callbacks.
- **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — wired status line, request-access button, transcribe button (enabled only when granted and idle), live-updating transcript label, and a `Completed in N.N s` line timed from tap to final result.
- **`app/assets/sample.wav`** (new) — copy of `spec-assets/sample.wav` placed where the Vite plugin's static-copy step bundles it into the app; loaded at runtime via `knownFolders.currentApp()`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — added the Speech framework type declaration reference.

`ns build ios` succeeds. I haven't run it in the Simulator to exercise the permission/transcription flow live — say the word if you'd like me to launch it and walk the golden path (request → grant → transcribe → deny) interactively.
